constructor: Normalized Miller coefficient binary recurrence; g=Z(R)+c*y(R)*(alpha+beta*c*(x(R)-x(P))), c=Z(P)/y(P), normalized nonzero Legendre character.
cost: Setup O(log r), predicate O(log r+log p), conditional recovery O(log r*(log r+log p)) plus public verification; separately charge trial-division certification and public coordinate census. Search charges all40 candidate arms; setup reused over13targets and charged once per group.

fresh_recovery.gate: After all13target outcomes for a group, check H(O)=0 and the exact public two-pulse equation using public mP/-P and point addition. This validation costs O(r) fixed-fixture work and is charged separately; no scalartruth is consulted.
fresh_recovery.gate_failure: No recovery attempt; explicit UNDEFINED_COVERAGE or IDENTITY_OR_TWO_PULSE_FAILURE reason, zero predicateevaluations.
fresh_recovery.gate_pass: Fresh public-input preparation once per group, then actual conditional_recover for each13target using five fresh Prepared.evaluate calls, publicdoublings and finalscalarverification. No retainedbit/table/candidate k is passed to constructor.
fresh_recovery.cost_separation: Keep freshsetup, freshpredicateevaluation, reductiondoublings/finalcheck and O(r) gate counters separate from fixedgrid counters. Validationgate cost is included in complete campaign accounting; no asymptotic solver advantage is claimed.
fresh_recovery.records: recovery.jsonl has5760group records plus full fresh publicquery/answer/counter traces when attempted; no change to74880grid rows. Independentverifier checks eachfreshtrace using its separatelycharged O(r) primitiveoracle and independently verifies recoveryequations. Its retainedbit reduction diagnostic is validator-only and is never counted as freshcandidate calls.

positive_control_scope: Truth-half is constructed with O(r) verifier scalar enumeration. It tests the validator and conditional recovery only, not candidate success.
pass: One fixed integer template defined and correct for all13targets/all12bases/all10views, exact two-pulse law, primitive/covariance controls and publicly verified conditional recovery. Finite exact result only; no global proof/novelty inference.
failure: Retain exact first counterexample, full outcomes/residuals and undefined reasons per fixedtemplate. Ifall40fail stopthisfixedgrammar; nofittedreplacement, nofreshcohort. Software/infrastructurefault isnotmathematicalfailure.
